adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework closed worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 blockers: Figure 1 whole-hemolymph antibacterial activity is captured with approximate source values; DRAMP/dbAMP peptide activity overreach is preserved as source_conflict; final acceptance is caution-bearing rather than clean.

materials_exhausted.note: Local supplementary landing files and JPEGs were checked; they are original figure files, not independent assay tables. No external absent supplement is required for the retained caution-bearing result.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Sequence and citation evidence for DRAMP04419/dbAMP_15592 were rechecked against Table 1, Figure 4, linked database rows, and merged sequence rows. The mature sequence is supported, but database antimicrobial labels remain source_conflict because the paper has no peptide-specific assay.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Figure 1 and Methods support two whole-hemolymph E. coli D31 inhibition rows in gentamycin-equivalent units/ml. No peptide MIC, hemolysis, or cytotoxicity values are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology is limited to direct whole-hemolymph antibacterial context, sequence-homology putative effector evidence, and immune-induction context; no direct peptide mechanism is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: Local supplementary assets were checked and consist of original figure image files plus landing HTML, with no independent assay tables.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Activity rows are Figure 1 whole-hemolymph E. coli D31 inhibition values, not MIC/MBC rows for isolated Et-AMP peptides.
DRAMP/dbAMP sequence/citation/source organism can be reconciled to Et-AMP1/eristalin, but database antimicrobial labels are not peptide-specific assay evidence in the primary source.
Figure 1 has no local tabulated numeric values; raw values are stored as explicit figure-estimated approximations and not normalized.
Landing HTML identifies local supplementary JPEG assets as authors original submitted files for figures 1-8; no separate assay spreadsheet/table was recovered.

source_limitations: No local XML/PDF/supplementary table gives exact numeric Figure 1 bar heights or SD values.
No local primary-source peptide-specific MIC, MBC, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, or target-organism assay was recovered for Et-AMP1/eristalin or other Et-AMP peptides.
